<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>Mars.Core</id>
    <version>6.0.0</version>
    <title>Mas.Core</title>
    <authors>Daniel Glake</authors>
    <icon>icon.png</icon>
    <projectUrl>https://www.mars-group.org/</projectUrl>
    <description>The runtime core provides step-based execution for
            multi-agent simulations in distributed environments as well as polyglot result output with different output types such as (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, CSV, GeoJson Socket, ...).

            For furher details please use the documentation:
            https://www.mars-group.org/docs/tutorial/intro</description>
    <copyright>MARS GROUP 2024</copyright>
    <tags>numeric simulation agent gis data</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/MARS-Group-HAW/life" commit="a119b7d629c6582a30f1843b14b79e57efebf19f" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net10.0">
        <dependency id="Mars.Common" version="6.0.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Autofac" version="8.0.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp" version="4.8.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Common" version="4.8.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Microsoft.Data.Sqlite" version="8.0.2" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="MongoDB.Driver" version="2.23.1" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="NetTopologySuite.IO.GeoJSON" version="4.0.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="NetTopologySuite.IO.ShapeFile" version="2.1.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Npgsql.NetTopologySuite" version="8.0.2" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="System.ComponentModel.Annotations" version="5.0.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="System.Data.DataSetExtensions" version="4.5.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
